# A module that took the route table into its own hands: it names a host,
# an endpoint, and a public client credential that only routes.py may
# name. It is stored with a .txt suffix so it can never be imported or
# discovered; it exists only to prove the ownership scan discriminates.

SEARCH_ENDPOINT = "https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/"
PROFILE_APP_ID = "936619743392459"


def fetch(query):
    return SEARCH_ENDPOINT + "?q=" + query
